sources.quote:
Hi, this is Ivy! ​I am an assistant professor of marketing at
HKU Business School
. My research focuses on the economics of information in the domain of quantitative marketing. I study how consumers search for information, how information influences their choices and the information provision strategies of firms. My interests also extend to social media marketing. I explore the effects of Marketer-Generated Content (MGC), User-Generated Content (UGC) and AI-Generated
Content
(AIGC) on social media. I also study the emerging trends in live-commerce and influencer marketing.
​
I joined
The University of Hong Kong
in 2020, after receiving my Ph.D. in marketing from
CUHK Business School
. I hold a M.S. in economics from
CUHK
and a B.S. in applied physics from
BJTU
. Before studying business and economics, I also spent two years in
RB Liu Lab
doing research in quantum information
as a
HKPFS
PhD candidate in physics. In my spare time, I enjoy running, hiking and playing with my little one.
I co-organized the 14th Consumer Search and Switching Costs Workshop in Hong Kong in June 2025.
​​
​
